wtf.sense: phrase: Alternative letter-case form of WTF.
wtf.hook: Wiktionary gives no earlier form for this sense.

wtfpwn.sense: verb: To dominate or defeat thoroughly (as in a video game).

firstUse.quote: Up until the point where some uninvited guests show up to act as assholes and wtfpwn them.... during the wake.
firstUse.source: 2006 April 15, Lazarhat, “When virtual funerals for real people go bad....”, in alt.buddha.short.fat.guy (Usenet):

wtfpwning.sense: verb: present participle and gerund of wtfpwn
wtfpwning.hook: Wiktionary gives no earlier form for this sense.

wtfpwned.sense: verb: simple past and past participle of wtfpwn
wtfpwned.hook: Wiktionary gives no earlier form for this sense.
